entries.title: Large-scale universality in quantum reaction-diffusion from Keldysh field theory
entries.summary: Studies quantum reaction-diffusion in a Fermi gas with pair annihilation and derives a large-scale universal kinetic equation using Keldysh field theory. It predicts density-decay exponents that differ from mean-field theory and shows confinement drives the decay back toward mean-field-like behavior.

entries.title: Adaptive control of reaction-diffusion PDEs via neural operator-approximated gain kernels ✩
entries.summary: Uses neural operators to approximate PDE backstepping gain kernels for adaptive control of a reaction-diffusion equation with an unknown spatially varying reaction coefficient. The paper proves global stability and asymptotic regulation, and reports substantial online speedups over finite-difference kernel solvers.
